pacing_followup.scope: Same installed APK; Nova, Ultimate Spider-Man rooftop, 4:3, IR 1.5x, framegen OFF, Host VSync OFF, Skip Presenting Duplicate Frames ON. Controlled camera pan and stationary checks.
pacing_followup.copy_control: User-authorized brief pause of the transfer parent and its exact remote SHA-256 verifier, with finally and independent timed resume safeguards. Both processes resumed after each sample.
pacing_followup.interpretation: Hitches occurred with the transfer paused, so it is not the sole cause. Short zero-outlier samples did not hold across longer tests. The combined timing settings produced the best longer sample but occasional misses remain; settings trials are not a randomized causal benchmark.
pacing_followup.transfer_active_repeat: A longer 92.78-second moving sample with both settings ON and transfer active still contained three intervals over 25 ms, maximum 50.02 ms.
pacing_followup.longer_clean_repeat: A 109.33-second moving sample with Sync To Host Refresh Rate and Threaded Presentation ON, Host VSync OFF and transfer paused still had three intervals over 25 ms, maximum 33.36 ms. The zero-outlier short sample did not establish a lock.
pacing_followup.sampling_note: Each sample includes approximately two seconds of SurfaceFlinger rolling history; these are buffer timestamps, not a count of unique simulated frames.
pacing_followup.final_choice: On Nova only, retained Sync To Host Refresh Rate, Host VSync and Threaded Presentation ON. Framegen OFF. The all-three-ON trial had one 33.36 ms interval in 109.28 seconds; this is the most consistent longer tested sample, not proof of a universal or sustained lock. No APK or shipped defaults changed in this follow-up.
pacing_followup.preservation: Eight original save/card files, the added session backup and seven external configs match their prior SHA-256 hashes. Only the three tested timing preferences are intentionally retained; temporary controls and FPS visibility are restored.
